# Prismal Budget

> Prismal Budget (https://prismalbudget.org) is a web budgeting app built around a four-week calendar. Each day lists its entries (costs and gains), and the budget projects "In Bank", the money in your budget's bank account at the end of every day, so negative days show up before they happen. Recurring entries fill themselves in, and so do entries from spreadsheets you connect (Google Sheets, Excel, and more, with a verified email); placeholders stand in for entries you expect (like an estimate) and are deleted once their day passes; an entry for an Other Account can be a percent of that account's balance; goals show how far along you are; a tracker adds up spending by category; Other Accounts (like Savings, or a credit card with monthly interest) track money outside the budget's account. It's for people 18 and older.

## Docs

- [How Prismal Budget Works](https://prismalbudget.org/how-it-works.html): the complete guide. Every page and feature, the starfield background (its hidden keyboard, pointer, and touch controls, and how the device's reduced motion setting turns it off), the budget math, entry formats and refraction types (Regular, Hidden, Transfer), placeholders (shown in yellow, counted like any entry, and deleted once their day passes), recurring frequencies, connected spreadsheets (how they're shared, read, and kept up to date), the daily update, Other Accounts (their interest, % entries worked out from an account's balance, and their balances 6 months ahead), goals under Dave's message, the site's sounds and music (and how they stay out of the way of your own audio), the tracker, search (on Home and History, exact or partial titles, and within the Tracker and Change Logs), Dave's tips, Quick Entry (In Bank and the lowest at its top and on an Apple Watch, changing or deleting entries still waiting, other devices' entries waiting on Home to be added or deleted, and steps for each kind of phone), undo and redo, fixing History entries without changing balances, reminders, dates (how they are stored, shown in each device's date format, picked with the site's own date picker, and kept steady across time zones), using the site in other languages (browser translation), passkey sign-in (Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, and the device's last passkey tried by itself), accounts (username and password rules, verified emails and other emails that sign in, staying signed in, signing out everywhere), data storage and protection against overwriting changes made on another device, how updates reach browsers (file fingerprints), downloading your data, the API, and design decisions.
- [Privacy Policy & Terms of Use](https://prismalbudget.org/privacy%20and%20terms.html): what is collected and how it's used.
